Usage: rhythm sightread signals [--json]

Lists every signal Sightread can raise, in catalogue order, with its default
severity, confidence, the ecosystems it applies to and the title reports use.
Config signals.severity changes a severity for one project. Read one in full
with rhythm sightread explain <id>.

Flags:
  --json   print the signals document as JSON (rhythm-sightread/v1, kind
           signals)

Examples:
  rhythm sightread signals
  rhythm sightread signals --json
